title: Attrition Monitoring & Drivers — Retention Manager Dashboard
description: Single-page dashboard to monitor overall attrition and identify key behavioral and demographic drivers to inform retention actions. Intended for retention managers to quickly spot high-risk segments (by income, card type, spend quartile) and investigate behavioral signals linked to churn.
primary_use_case: Monitor attrition distribution, prioritize high-risk cohorts, and surface behavioral drivers to guide targeted interventions.
layout_description: One-page layout with a KPI header, two columns below: left column focuses on segments (income, card, spend), right column focuses on behavioral drivers and cohort diagnostics. Bottom row contains a cohort cross-tab table and an actionable segments table for targeted outreach.

kpis.title: Overall Attrition Rate
kpis.description: Percent of customers labeled as Attrited Customer (churn_flag = 1).

kpis.title: Avg Trans Count — Churn vs Retained
kpis.description: Average Total_Trans_Ct for churners and non-churners (side-by-side to highlight behaviour).

visuals.title: Attrition Mix
visuals.purpose: Quick visual of overall churn vs retained counts to give immediate sense of scale

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Income Bracket
visuals.purpose: Show which income groups have higher-than-average churn; sort by churn rate descending

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Card Category
visuals.purpose: Compare churn across card products (identify product-specific retention issues)

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Spend Quartile
visuals.purpose: Test relationship between spending levels and churn; highlight low-spend risk

visuals.title: Top Numeric Correlates with Churn
visuals.purpose: Surface strongest numeric predictors (from metrics_summary) so retention managers know which behaviours to monitor

visuals.title: Distribution: Total_Trans_Ct by Churn
visuals.purpose: Show distribution differences in transaction counts between churners and retained (boxplot)

visuals.title: Cohort Matrix — Attrition Rate (Income x Card)
visuals.purpose: Cross-tab to find specific income+card cohorts with elevated churn; supports drill-down to list of customers

visuals.title: Top Actionable Segments
visuals.purpose: Ranked table of segments (pre-defined segments: low-income low-spend, high-income high-churn, low Months_on_book, high Revolving Balance) showing size and churn rate to prioritize outreach

limitations: No date/time columns in dataset — time-series or cohort lifetime visualizations are not possible from this cleaned dataset.
CLIENTNUM is retained (PII) — mask before sharing; cleaned dataset notes recommend masking.
Churn label is a static snapshot (Attrition_Flag) — cannot compute time-to-churn or survival without transaction date/time data.
Correlations and feature importances are observational; do not imply causation. Validate with experiments before action.
